title: Mobile Wallet Sending and the Bank Deposit Shortfall Delivery Rate
content:
A customer's Mobile Wallet sending earns a wallet rate bonus on the make-good delivery rate of a Bank Deposit shortfall delivery. The bonus is in percentage points of the booking-day reference.

## Records read

The customer's Mobile Wallet credits sent: the entries on the ledgers of the customer's Mobile Wallet transfers recording that principal was sent to the wallet provider for credit to the recipient's wallet, each with its date. A wallet credit counts when fewer than twelve whole calendar months separate its date from the handling date.

## Clause

A customer with at least 5 Mobile Wallet credits sent in the last twelve months earns the high wallet bonus of 0.20 percentage points; one with at least 3 but fewer than 5 earns the mid wallet bonus of 0.10 percentage points; anyone else earns no wallet rate bonus.

| Mobile Wallet credits sent in the last twelve months | Wallet rate bonus |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 0.20 percentage points |
| 3 or 4 | 0.10 percentage points |
| 0 to 2 | none |

## Hypothetical cases

- 5 credits sent in the last twelve months: 0.20.
- 4 credits: 0.10.
- 2 credits in the last twelve months and 6 more dated 13 to 18 months before the handling date: only the 2 count, so none.
- Handling on 15 October 2026: a credit dated 16 October 2025 counts (11 whole calendar months); one dated 15 October 2025 does not (12 whole calendar months).
